Implementation complete — all four criteria groups are green, and nothing outside the plan's manifest was touched.

## What I changed

**`src/models/cards/CardsRepository.ts`** — `deleteCard` now cascades (D-010, D-011). One `database.write` fetches the card and, with exactly `Q.where('card_id', cardId)` on `transactions`, its rows; a single `database.batch` destroys the transactions and the card together. This also covers the second entry point, `CardDetailScreen`.

**`src/features/cards/components/CardItem.tsx`** — two new optional props, `inactive` (default `false`) and `onDelete` (D-003); no store import. When `inactive`, the content renders, in order: the `card-inactive` wash (first child, `pointerEvents="none"`, so badge and control paint above it — D-004), a pill with `card-disconnected-badge` reading `Disconnected` (D-005), and a `card-delete` `Pressable` with `accessibilityLabel="Delete card"` whose presence depends on `inactive` alone (D-006). Its press raises a copy of `CardDetailScreen`'s `Delete card?` sheet, whose `Delete` action (variant `danger`) calls `onDelete?.()` (D-007).

**`src/features/cards/components/CardItem.styles.ts`** — `inactiveOverlay`, `disconnectedBadge`, `deleteControl`, built from `surface` / `border` / `textMuted` (via `tone="tertiary"`); no new token, no migration (D-013).

**`src/features/cards/components/CardStack.tsx`** — deep-imports `useMonobankStore` (D-002), derives `inactive = monobankStatus !== 'connected' && card.type === 'monobank'` per card at render (D-001), gates only the press path with `onPress={inactive ? undefined : onCardPress}` (D-009), and passes `onDelete={() => deleteCard(card.id)}` from `useCardsStore` (D-008). `onLongPress`, `delayLongPress` and the `PanResponder` are unchanged.

**`src/features/monobank/state/useMonobankStore.ts`** — deliberately untouched. It is in `files.change`, but D-012 says leave `connect` and `disconnect` alone; their suites (AC-001, AC-002, AC-013, AC-015 and the inherited OPES-64 cases) were already green before and after.

## Verification

- `npx jest` on the five test files: 61 passed, 0 failed. Before the change, 7 cases failed (AC-003, AC-004, AC-005, AC-008, AC-009, AC-011, AC-014).
- `npm test`: 30 suites, 201 tests, all passing.
- `npx tsc --noEmit`: clean.
- `npm run lint` (eslint + the test-convention guard): clean.
- `git status`: only the four source files above, plus the pipeline's own `tasks/OPES-68/run.json`, which was already modified when I started. No test file touched, no new file, no manifest amendment needed.

One thing worth a reviewer's eye, not a blocker: D-004 puts the wash as the *first* child of the content, so in RN's paint order it sits below the header and body rather than over them — it greys the card's background, and the badge and delete control sit above it as the decision intends, but the title and amount are not themselves dimmed. Whether that reads as a tombstone is the device check the tests already flag as VG-001.
